title: Ream
tagline: Ream is a go-to analytical site that displays the asset(tokens), treasury, reciepts and payment, investment position in defi protocols of decentralized organization(DAO). This solution seeks to help DAO's get a performance glance of their funds, track assets, and portfolio value
description: Ream presents a fascinating landing page for users, which takes them through the features of the product. The landing page consist of a call-to-action that enable users get started with exploring the possibilities of the app. It incorporates a dashboard, and on this dashboard, there is a search field that gives a list of DAO's to check their performance from. The dashboard houses the core functionality of the application. The dashboard consist of list of assets, treasury of DAO over time, investments in defi protocols like Aave, Compound if any.
how_its_made: Ream's core functionality rely solely on the covalent api to get all of its needed data which serves as the backend. For the beautiful frontend, react framework was implemented.
